lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Second date, no restaurant. Just the long way home through night streets.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Streets you usually only hear about through a headset.

lines.speaker: date
lines.text: So this is your city off the clock. Quieter than you make it sound.

lines.speaker: date
lines.text: Fair warning: I overshare on walks. It's the low lighting.

lines.speaker: date
lines.text: Dropped out of college twice, finished the third time. Your turn eventually.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They trade a story for nothing, easy as breath.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a corner. Your steps slow without asking permission.

lines.speaker: date
lines.text: You went quiet just there. Rough call once?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They noticed. Of course they noticed.

choices.label: Change the subject with a joke.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You tell it plainly, no drama. They don't flinch, don't pity.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They just move a half step closer for the rest of the walk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A promise shaped like a door left open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The joke lands, the laugh is real, and the corner stays yours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some walls take longer than others.
